hero.workMode: Open to Onsite, Hybrid, or Remote work
hero.paragraph1: I am a Full Stack Web Developer focused on building modern, fast, and responsive websites. I have a strong interest in creating applications that are not only visually appealing but also have optimal performance and are easy to maintain.
hero.paragraph2: I currently work with technologies such as Next.js, Laravel, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and MySQL. I also enjoy learning new technologies to keep improving the quality of the solutions I build.
hero.paragraph3: For me, writing code isn't just about making an application run — it's about creating a comfortable user experience, keeping the codebase maintainable, and delivering a product that genuinely benefits its users.

about.title: About
about.description: A brief introduction about who I am.
about.paragraph1: I'm <name>Fajar Ferdiansyah</name>, a Software Engineer based in Ciamis, dedicated to building impactful digital solutions. I specialize in web platform and mobile app development using modern tech stacks, including Next.js, TypeScript, and native Android development with Kotlin.
about.paragraph2: My main focus is designing software architecture that is not only functional but also well-structured, maintainable, and scalable to meet business needs. I believe high-quality code should go hand in hand with system efficiency and logical clarity.
about.paragraph3: I combine technical expertise with proactive communication, critical thinking, and effective time management. I thrive in collaborative environments and leverage leadership skills to ensure every project delivers optimal results and real impact.

pkl.name: SMKN 1 Kawali Internship Management System
pkl.description: An internship management platform to help students and schools digitally monitor internship activities.
pkl.longDescription: The Internship System is a web application developed at the school's request to digitize the student internship (PKL) process. It includes location-based attendance, daily activity journals, automated letter management, and real-time progress monitoring by the school and industry supervisors.

approvalFlow.title: Multi-Level Approval Workflow
approvalFlow.description: One of the biggest challenges was designing an internship placement submission flow involving multiple parties in sequence. Students submit their chosen internship site (IDUKA), which must first be approved by the Head of Study Program (Kaprog) for their respective major, then forwarded to the IDUKA, and finally the official letter is printed through the school's printing division. Ensuring each submission's status stayed synchronized and easily traceable at every stage was the most complex part of building this system.
